purpose: Where SP replaces the Japanese text, the same in every language: [start, end) byte ranges of the decoded COMPDATA.BN and of STAGE.BIN chunk 0 (scenario chart) that the SP translation changes. Exported once (2026-11-21) from the September SP baseline; tools/zh_hant/sp_tc_baseline.py keeps a language's text only inside these ranges and fills SP-only strings at them.
